snapshot.scope: Bounded current C++ capability/evidence summary with the engineering SDK archive overlay on the source commit, not whole-catalog acceptance. No new SystemVue execution.
snapshot.integration_note: The base contains native fixed-pump PHD coefficients. This overlay adds internal header-only SDK archive production, actual Git provenance, integrity/containment checks and installed-only consumers. Local developer archives are explicitly dirty and do not identify an exact source commit; the final published archive integration commit needs its own exact-commit CI. No public release, license selection or new vendor compatibility is established.
